exact_statement: For the distinct-Finset Erdős 786 hypergraph H_N on {2,...,N}, prove tau(H_N)=o(N), and for every epsilon>0 construct by one coherent compatible rule an infinite admissible set whose natural-density limit exists and is greater than 1-epsilon.
scope_notes: Variant lock: products are over finite sets of distinct positive integers on each shore. After cancelling overlap, coefficients lie in {-1,0,1}; repetitions within a shore are forbidden.
The finite target is an integral transversal D_N of every bad support in {2,...,N} with |D_N|=o(N).

The infinite target separately requires one compatible infinite rule for every epsilon whose admitted set has an actual natural-density limit greater than 1-epsilon. Unrelated finite transversals, endpoint density, upper density, or logarithmic density do not suffice.
Read-only input F786: w_N(n)=log(N/n)/log N is an audited fractional cover with total (1+o(1))N/log N.

Read-only input IR.1 and RR.1--RR.3: hard moving lower tails, bounded local residue/depth schemes, forest/cycle-rank safety, raw max-degree LLL, and per-circuit internal representatives are closed routes.

The only retained families are full failure-cluster alteration retaining normalized defect, global full-cofactor-residue owner flow, and a multiscale telescoping potential with a coherent zero-density revision reserve.
A finite o(N) transversal does not automatically imply the infinite natural-density claim; the campaign must prove a compatibility or stabilization theorem.
Public search for an exact solution to Erdos 786 is prohibited. Ordinary named background theorems may be used with exact hypotheses.

variant_lock.allowed: two finite subsets of distinct positive integers, overlap cancelled
variant_lock.forbidden: multiplicity within a shore or arbitrary integer coefficients
variant_lock.exceptional_elements: 1 is forced out; 0 is outside the positive-integer domain

read_only_dependencies.result: audited residue-complexity package RR.1--RR.3 and alteration subroute obstructions

exact_subproblems.finite: Construct an integral transversal D_N of all bad supports with |D_N|=o(N).
exact_subproblems.cluster_alteration: Contract complete arithmetic failure clusters while retaining normalized defect and charge total repair o(log N) times a disjoint circuit packing.
exact_subproblems.owner_flow: Assign every residual bad support to full cofactor-residue owner data with o(log N) aggregate congestion without circularly re-encoding the original relation.
exact_subproblems.coherent_potential: Give a multiscale potential whose total increase pays all finite repairs and whose revision reserve has zero upper density, yielding actual natural-density convergence.
